title: EdgeCatTask
description: A single eval task for EdgeCat orchestration. One JSONL line per task.

prompt.description: The user message sent to EdgeCat. Mutually exclusive with `turns`.

turns.description: Multi-turn conversation. Each turn's prompt is sent sequentially within a single conversation; the runner waits for the agent's reply before sending the next turn. Verifier (top-level) runs after the final turn. Mutually exclusive with `prompt`. Runtime support pending — runner currently skips these.

category.description: Skill domain: calendar, alarm, sms, contacts, web, calculator, device, chat, multi, other

expected_skills.description: Skill names the planner is expected to pick. Empty means any/none (chat/refuse).

expected_args_contract.description: Optional per-skill arg shape checks. Keyed by skill name.

check.description: For state/output_regex: a verifier function reference or regex. Scorer resolves it.

params.description: Params passed to the verifier function.

should_refuse.description: True if the agent should refuse (no matching skill / unsafe / unclear).

budget_ms.description: Latency budget in ms. A task that completes past this is reported as budget_bust (informational by default; use --enforce-latency-budget to count as TSR=0). Defaults to timeout_s * 500 (half the hard timeout).

setup.description: Optional setup commands run on device before the task (adb shell snippets).

teardown.description: Optional teardown commands run on device after the task.

notes.description: Human notes about why this task exists / what it stresses.
